claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The supplied image shows a black sports car with a carbon fibre body.
The car is on an empty showroom floor.
A moving highlight glides along the car's carbon-fibre body as it emerges from shadow into light.
A low engine hum and soft tyre roll accompany the forward movement over the showroom floor.

description.text: At the opening instant, the entire supplied showroom image remains intact, with the black sports car positioned on the empty floor and the surrounding space holding its full composition.
The car sits low and broad, its carbon-fibre body dark against the pale showroom surface, while the deeper background stays in shadow.
As the shot begins, the car eases forward from that shadowed depth, its movement slow and deliberate, and the darkness behind it gradually recedes as more of the floor becomes visible.

The front of the car crosses into the light first, and a moving highlight travels along the long carbon-fibre panels, tracing the edge of the hood, the curve of the fender and the shallow slope of the roof.

The pale floor beneath the car carries a soft, stretching reflection that changes shape with the advance, and the car's shadow shortens and slides backward as the light reaches further across the body.
The wheels turn with a measured, heavy rhythm, and the low stance keeps the car close to the ground as it moves clear of the darkest area.
The empty showroom remains quiet around it, with the foreground floor smooth and open, the car centered in the available space, and no other object interrupting the path ahead.
The forward glide continues without a sudden burst; the car maintains a steady, controlled pace, letting the shift from shadow to light read clearly across the bodywork.
By the end of the shot, the car has moved forward enough to sit in the brighter part of the showroom, while the rear of the body is still touched by the fading darkness behind it.
The carbon-fibre surface holds a cool, glassy sheen, and the contrast between the dark body and the pale floor grows sharper as the car advances.
The complete supplied showroom frame is held at the opening instant: the black sports car rests on the empty floor with the shadowed background behind it.
The car eases forward from the dark toward the light at a slow, deliberate pace.
A low engine hum and soft tyre roll begin as the car moves.
The front body enters the brighter area, and a highlight moves along the carbon-fibre panels.
The car continues forward, now mostly in the brighter part of the showroom, while the rear remains touched by shadow.

soundscape: A low engine hum and soft tyre roll carry across the empty showroom floor, with a faint room tone beneath them.
